reviews.comment: Lockhart is an ok teacher I guess teaching style isn't bad but the way she tests is kind of annoying using both lock down browser and having to join a zoom call to be recorded(twice) it's causes way too much unnecessary stress about figuring out and making sure angles are right. You would think one recording is enough.

Professor Lockhart is one of the best professors! She is helpful and wants her students to succeed. This class is only challenging if you let it be. Watch the lecture videos, make good exam cheat sheets, use AI ONLY to study and solidify your understanding, and ask for help. An A is very feasible if you put in the time!

Genuinely take her. She is the sweetest professor and she really wants us to do well. She constantly argues for the exams to be more fair. Honestly I have not heard of any prof being better than her for stats so it's your best shot.
Professor Lockhart was great at explaining things! The course also gives you formula sheets for exams! But don't be fooled still study in advance for tests! Homework also takes a while to complete.
Dr. Lockhart is a great professor! She is very caring towards students, easy to talk to and wants them to succeed. Definitely take her class for STAT 201 if you can!

She is a great professor for this difficult of a class. it goes pretty slow so it's easy to stay caught up, however homework takes a while so start early. Study in advance for tests ,it will make it way easier, and they are weighted heavily. Formula sheets for everything is great too. Not unbearable, but need to go to class to be successful
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof. Lockhart is by far one of the most kindhearted Professors we will probably ever have here at TAMU. She is devoted, kind, cares about the students, and good at teaching. DONT LET MY GRADE FOOL YOU. The class is hard but don't be like me, try hard. She has helped me so so much and I know she will continue to have that same impact on many.
loved her. She's caring, easy to talk to, wants you to succeed, and easy to follow lectures.

This class was hell to take, but she was a good professor. she helped out a lot and fought for us to keep group quizzes. those really helped my grade. The tests really determine your overall grade, so study hard!! the lecture notes and practice exams are the best resources. also make sure your cheat sheet for the exams and quizzes are thorough.

Professor Lockhart is quite literally the best professor you could ask for!! Her lectures are super informative and she explains things so well! She gives great feedback and really cares about her students! Her sections always score the highest out of all the STAT201 classes because of her!!

Dr. Lockhart is one of the most caring professors I've had. She wants her students to do good. This class is definitely difficult only because 80% of your grade comes from very tricky exams. Don't underestimate the first one; study the lecture notes more than anything, yes even more than the practice exams.
Holy shit this class was hard. She is a good professor but the class overall it's very hard, don't take it if you don't have to. Only 3 exams worth 80%….the rest are hw and quizzes

The topics are not inherently difficult, but the class is graded EXTREMELY test-heavy which is why I assume the averages are so low. Just know that the tests care more about your understanding of CONCEPTS, not you being able to work difficult math problems, so be aware of how/what you are studying. Knowing why > knowing just how to calculate.

Kind woman. She is great but the exams are not made by her nor are the PowerPoints, so they are hard. Our class scored highest on exams, our average was a 67% . 4 quizzes, 14 Hw, 3 exams. I had a 97% all semester and flunked the 2nd exam, my grade went to an F. I recommend taking her extra credit and trying hard on quizzes, attend recitations!

To all math haters, like me, seriously take her. You will still hate it, because it's math, but she seriously cares about you. She is a one of a kind type of professor who will SERIOUSLY listen to you; stats related or not. Just do not make yourself even slightly suspicious taking tests/quizzes because you will be prosecuted....

AMAZING PROFESSOR!! although attendance is not mandatory, her lectors are super easy to understand and help so so much! 2 exams and one final--weigh 85% of your grade😖 quizzes, hws, extra credit only count for 15%. SHE GIVES YOU EVERYTHING YOU NEED TO BE SUCCESSFUL, BUT YOU HAVE TO STUDY AND DO YOUR PART!!

Mary Lockhart is an amazing professor; she was so kind and encouraging. I wish I had put more effort into this class to get an A because it is attainable! The thing that screwed me up the most was the quizzes. In my opinion the Exams were easier than the quizzes. But she was understanding and dropped the two lowest quizzes.
reviews.ratingTags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This course is difficult (especially in the summer), but Professor Lockhart made it bearable. If you aren't willing to study and look at the videos everyday, do not take this course because you will fall behind. She curved our quiz grades by 10 points if you did surveys and she dropped our lowest quiz score ! She is truly a blessing.

Great professor. posts all lectures on Canvas for easy review but showing up matters! Homework is heavy, so stay ahead. Your grades rely heavily on exams, but Prof. allows you to bring a cheat sheet for the exams.

Fantastic prof! Lectures were clear and concise, and test reviews had actual quiz/exam questions, which really helped. Tons of extra credit opportunities (I ended with a 102!). She's willing to meet and explain concepts until you get it. Makes stats understandable and low-stress. Highly recommend!

She is so sweet!!!! I barely scraped by with an A bc Stats is a difficult subject but she is by far the best prof for 201, she fights for exams to be fair, and explains things so easy to understand, do good on exam 1, STUDY for exam 2 you'll do fine, she had a lot going on in her personal life but was always there for us, pray for her family

Fall 2024. She breaks down topics in an easy way and will fight for her students' success in form of fighting for unfair questions to be dropped. Posts online lectures if you do not wish to attend class. She has personality that makes her lectures interesting!

Professor Lockhart is EXACTLY the kind of professor you want and need as a college student. This course is tough, there are few assignments, all of which are heavily weighted, but she is passionate about what she does and prepares you well. She is both considerate and just, expecting you to work hard, but advocates for those who do. Take her!!

The course itself is weighted heavily towards exams but that is beyond her control (common course and exams). She is such a sweet lady that gives amazing lectures and knows her stuff. She advocates for us students and she cares so much about us and she shows. She is good at delivering material in a way that makes sense and feels easy

She is the best stat prof! Explains things very clearly and advocates for students with course coordinator for things to be fair. Easy to understand and such a sweet lady. Take her and go to class and you should be fine.

If you have to take Stats TAKE HER! Our exam averages were almost always 4-8 points higher than other prof's sections. Exams are worth 80% of your grade which is scary but if you study and do the hw and practice tests, its very doable to make As on them. Shes great. Always advocates for her students. No complaints about her
2 Midterms worth 25% each and a Final worth 30%. This course is test heavy but the first midterm was really easy. Practice exams really prepare you. You can bring notes to the exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I actually love her! She knows her stuff and responds very well to student feedback. She also works through examples better than most of the other professors I've had. The exam/quiz/homework questions are all the same, so you don't feel like exam material is stuff you've never seen before.

I was scared walking in, but Prof. Lockhart is great! The slideshows always have critical mistakes, but she always catches them for us. I cant emphasize enough how much she wants us to succeed. I did stop going to lecture at some point, but she posts online lectures too! Our test averages were always like 5 points higher than the other professors.

Lockhart is my goat! She explains things very clearly and is patient with her students. She does recaps of exam content during class which is super helpful if you skip sometimes. I wasn't locked in at the beginning of the semester so I got a B, but an A is very doable!
Amazing, super cute professor. She's extremely knowledgeable and always willing to answer questions and help outside of class. Lectures are not boring despite it being a statistics class.

She ate. This class is very test heavy, so you have to grind for those. Redo all the homework and practice tests and you'll be fine. The stats department is not it because they make mistakes on the notes, but Lockhart is always on our side. She does anything to help our grades. Every test had a curve of 4 points, and the final had a curve of 8.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She is the best! She cares very much for her students and it is so evident. The exams weren't too terrible, especially if you do the practice exams and review your notes. She gives wonderful study tips too! Attendance isn't mandatory but her lectures are INCREDIBLY helpful and help you grasp concepts better. TAKE HER YOU WONT REGRET IT

SHE IS SIMPLY THE BEST. If you have to take this class take it with Professor Lockhart. This is a hard class, you will have to try, and if you want an A you NEED to understand it conceptually.  She has been my favorite prof so far and that's saying something as someone who typically hates math and stats. She will fight for you to get a good grade.

Dr. Lockhart is a caring and good prof. However, she is very petty in term of her material. If you do not go to class for any reasons (include sick). Her lectures video is very bad and she wouldn't share any video regarding Friday lectures or review. Class is very test heavy. Not her fault but the course is FULL of mistake on slides, Practice exam.

Professor Lockhart fights for her students and prepares us well for exams! Because the course is full of common material, it was sometimes hard to get grades back on time and understand what was required, but Professor Lockhart was open and transparent. She was a wonderful professor who deeply cared for her students. I would take her again!!

She was the best prof I could've ended up with. She was not on RMP before this semester and the class I registered for was unassigned. Thank the lord it was her. She is patient, she cares about her students, and she wants us to succeed. It will feel like kindergarten for the first few weeks and then BAM, less #s and more symbols. Don't get behind.

She was a very sweet professor. I usually ALWAYS struggle in math but she made statistics so easy. I literally got a B. Each homework question had 6 attempts, so I always scored 100s. Quizzes were a bit hard, and exams were not that challenging tbh as long as you did the test review. TAKE HER.

she is the best! class doesnt move that fast, so its easy to stay on top of everything. the quizzes are pretty challenging, but theyre made by the department so its not her fault. i would take her again

Dr Lockhart is a strong advocate for her students as a lot of homework questions or lecture slides (department-wide, not her fault) are unfair or poorly worded, she explains concepts very clearly and makes material easy to understand, tries to be as fair as possible and is an overall great professor. I highly recommend taking her class!

Professor Lockhart does a good job of explaining topics and breaking them down nicely, she also tries her hardest to get unfair or poorly worded questions thrown out or challenged by the department. Attendance isn't mandatory, and if you haven't taken statistics before going into this course, be aware this is not like normal math.

Great teacher, very accessible through office hours, email, and HW question forum. Lecture videos if you skip class. Fights to get unfair questions dropped. Only con is there's only two university standardized exams that make up the majority of your grade and the quizzes are out of 8 with no partial credit. Not her fault though.
reviews.ratingTags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class
